_help: Your team's workflow. statuses: your Jira status names for each role the app knows. reports: the words your runbook tells runs to start their final report with. list_options: your Slack List's option keys (its Status / Waiting on columns) and the labels the app shows. hide.marker: tickets whose summary contains it get a 'Hide …' toggle; empty = none. messages: what the app posts for you in the review thread; {reviewer_mention} is the reviewer's Slack mention with its honorific, {reviewer_at} the '@Name' a draft starts with, {greet} one of greetings (morning / afternoon / evening); a line whose value is missing (e.g. no staging PR) is left out.
